an2.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an2.1:2.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco passati coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakaraṇā karonte
an2.1:2.6: kasāhipi tāḷente vettehipi tāḷente aḍḍhadaṇḍakehipi tāḷente hatthaṃpi chindante pādaṃpi chindante hatthapādaṃpi chindante kaṇṇaṃpi chindante nāsaṃpi chindante kaṇṇanāsaṃpi chindante bilaṅgathālikaṃpi karonte saṃkhamuṇḍikaṃpi karonte rāhumukhaṃpi karonte jotimālikaṃpi karonte hatthappajjotikaṃpi karonte erakavaṭṭikaṃpi karonte cīrakavāsikaṃpi karonte eṇeyyakaṃpi karonte baḷisamaṃsikaṃpi karonte kahāpaṇakaṃpi karonte khārāpaṭicchakaṃpi karonte palighaparivattakaṃpi karonte palālapīṭhakaṃpi karonte tattenapi telena osiñcante sunakhehipi khādāpente jīvantaṃpi sūle uttāsente asināpi sīsaṃ chindante
an2.1:3.2: yathārūpānaṃ kho pāpakānaṃ kammānaṃ hetu coraṃ āgucāriṃ rājāno gahetvā vividhā kammakaraṇā karonti
an2.1:3.4: ahañceva kho pana evarūpaṃ pāpakammaṃ kareyyaṃ maṃpī rājāno gahetvā evarūpā vividhā kammakaraṇā kareyyuṃ
an2.1:3.6: so diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhīto na paresaṃ pābhataṃ palumpanto carati
an2.1:4.3: kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ vacīduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ manoduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko abhisamparāyaṃ
an2.1:4.4: ahañceva kho pana kāyena duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ vācāya duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ manasā duccaritaṃ careyyaṃ
an2.1:4.5: kiñca taṃ yenāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjeyyanti
an2.1:4.6: so samparāyikassa vajjassa bhīto kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveti vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveti manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati
an2.1:4.10: diṭṭhadhammikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma samparāyikassa vajjassa bhāyissāma vajjabhīruno bhavissāma vajjabhayadassāvinoti
an2.1:4.12: vajjabhīruno bhikkhave vajjabhayadassāvino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ parimuccissati sabbavajjehīti. 2
an2.2:1.3: yañca gihīnaṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasataṃ cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsana- gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānuppādanatthaṃ padhānaṃ yañca agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitānaṃ sabbupadhipaṭinissaggatthaṃ padhānaṃ
an2.2:1.4: imāni kho bhikkhave dve padhānāni durabhisambhavāni lokasmiṃ
an2.2:2.1: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dvinnaṃ padhānānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbupadhipaṭinissaggatthaṃ padhānaṃ.
an2.3:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa kāyaduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti kāyasucaritaṃ
an2.3:1.4: vacīduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti vacīsucaritaṃ
an2.3:1.5: manoduccaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti manosucaritaṃ
an2.3:1.6: so kāyaduccaritaṃ me katanti tappati akataṃ me kāyasucaritanti tappati
an2.3:1.7: vacīduccaritaṃ me katanti tappati akataṃ me vacīsucaritanti tappati
an2.3:1.8: manoduccaritaṃ me katanti tappati akataṃ me manosucaritanti tappati
an2.3:1.9: ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā tapanīyāti. 4
an2.4:1.3: idha bhikkhave ekaccassa kāyasucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti kāyaduccaritaṃ
an2.4:1.4: vacīsucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti vacīduccaritaṃ
an2.4:1.5: manosucaritaṃ kataṃ hoti akataṃ hoti manoduccaritaṃ
an2.4:1.6: so kāyasucaritaṃ me katanti na tappati akataṃ me kāyaduccaritanti na tappati
an2.4:1.7: vacīsucaritaṃ me katanti na tappati akataṃ me vacīduccaritanti na tappati
an2.4:1.8: manosucaritaṃ me katanti na tappati akataṃ me manoduccaritanti na tappati
an2.4:1.9: ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā atapanīyāti. 5
an2.5:1.2: yā ca asantuṭṭhitā kusalesu dhammesu yā ca appaṭivāṇitā padhānasmiṃ.
an2.5:1.4: kāmaṃ taco nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yantaṃ purisatthāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti
an2.5:1.5: tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave appamādādhigatā bodhi appamādādhigato anuttaro yogakkhemo.
an2.5:1.7: kāmaṃ taco nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasissatu sarīre upasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yantaṃ purisatthāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa saṇṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti tumhepi bhikkhave na cirasseva
an2.5:1.8: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharissatha.

an2.6:1.3: yā ca saññojaniyesu dhammesu assādānupassitā yā ca saññojaniyesu dhammesu nibbidānupassitā.
an2.6:1.4: saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu assādānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ nappajahati dosaṃ nappajahati mohaṃ nappajahati
an2.6:1.5: rāgaṃ appahāya dosaṃ appahāya mohaṃ appahāya na parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
an2.6:2.1: saññojaniyesu bhikkhave dhammesu nibbidānupassī viharanto rāgaṃ pajahati dosaṃ pajahati mohaṃ pajahati
an2.6:2.2: rāgaṃ pahāya dosaṃ pahāya mohaṃ pahāya parimuccati jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
an2.7:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā kaṇhāti. 8
an2.8:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave dve dhammā sukkāti. 9
an2.9:1.1: dveme bhikkhave sukkā dhammā lokaṃ pālenti
an2.9:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ na pāleyyuṃ nayidha paññāyetha mātāti vā mātucchāti vā mātulānīti vā ācariyabhariyāti vā garūnaṃ dārāti vā
an2.9:1.5: sambhedaṃ loko agamissa yathā ajeḷakā kukkuṭasūkarā soṇasigālā.
an2.9:1.6: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave ime dve sukkā dhammā lokaṃ pālenti tasmā paññāyati mātāti vā mātucchāti vā mātulānīti vā ācariyabhariyāti vā garūnaṃ dārāti vāti. 10
